name: Oda Nobunaga
source:
An extraordinary man and providential hero during the Warring States Period, also feared as the Demon of the Sixth Heaven.

He is summoned as the main character's "father."

He seems to know some things about his situation from the beginning, and speaks in riddles to try and test you.

[From in-game profile]
